summary_ko: 실제 oneM2M 공통 서비스·다중 바인딩·PM2.5 한정 SDT 및 수정된 명령/ACK/결과 흐름을 확인했다. 기존 핵심 동작 결함의 종료 근거는 충분하다. 후보 커밋의 SDT 전송 라벨 오류를 고쳐야 하며, 이미 열린 Codex 사용자 안내 단위 오류 R-027/R-031 때문에 전체 완료를 승인하지 않는다.

limits: ACME member denial aborts the native aggregate. Explicitly labeled individual diagnostic reads after failure are application fallback, not a native mixed-success aggregate.
Group CRUD success is not actuator execution; per-command ACK and later observations remain separate.

criteria_assessment.official_descriptor_applied: Expert: devices/applications use multiple different protocols according to communication conditions.
criteria_assessment.assessment_ko: 가상 어댑터의 관측·ACK·SDT 갱신은 실제 CSE MQTT/TLS 바인딩, 서비스 조회·명령은 HTTPS이다. 장비 발행과 앱 요청의 역할 분리가 명확하여 Expert 구간을 지지한다.
limits: Anonymous loopback MQTT and trusted local origin headers do not prove production device authentication.
Local API/callback and distributed Mcc are HTTP. Secure single-installation and distributed HTTP captures are alternatives, not one all-TLS multisite run.

criteria_assessment.official_descriptor_applied: Proficient: multiple simple devices such as sensor and actuator through a CSE/application. Expert additionally requires complex device/multiple complex applications and actual reuse of oneM2M service functions.
criteria_assessment.assessment_ko: 서로 다른 프로필·제조사 형식, 진단·운영·정비·어댑터의 실제 AE/ACP 책임, 장애·ACK·후속 관측 검증과 분산 자원 공유를 확인했다. Proficient는 확실히 지지되며 Expert 판단을 뒷받침하는 구체적 복잡성이 있다. 다만 단순 센서+댐퍼, AE 수 또는 51개 시각화 노드 수만으로 Expert/최고점을 자동 부여하지 않는다.
limits: Physical device behavior is simulated; no physical capture adequacy or health benefit is established.
Logical roles are cohosted, not independently deployed production services.
Maintenance-record creation does not itself establish physical repair or recovery.
Actual Codex grounded-user-handoff acceptance remains incomplete under R-027/R-031.

criteria_assessment.official_descriptor_applied: Proficient: FCNT model plus application-purpose discovery. Expert: advanced semantic/SAREF or SDT TS-0023 model use.
criteria_assessment.assessment_ko: TS-0023 v5.6.0 airQualitySensor의 cod:aiQSr/cnd, 정수형 비음수 PM2.5 µg/m³ 투영, 실제 ty=28 발견·타입 거절·앱 읽기를 확인했다. 제한된 PM2.5 범위에서 고급 SDT 서술을 지지한다.
limits: Canonical CIN retains original float precision and observed/received timestamps. The SDT projection rounds with Python round, ties-to-even.
CO2 ppm is not assigned to SDT mass concentration; volume airflow m³/h is not mapped to airFlow speed.
No SAREF, whole-device conformance certification or freshness guarantee from the latest projected value alone.
The Codex explanatory unit error is downstream of correctly unit-bearing tool data; it does not invalidate CSE SDT mapping, but prevents an unqualified user-handoff pass.
